# FlareMinds

> FlareMinds is a leading digital agency offering custom web development, mobile app development, SEO analytics, social media marketing, and business automation solutions.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://www.flaremindstech.com/): Digital agency landing page showcasing branding, services, portfolio, and strategic digital solutions.
- [About Us](https://www.flaremindstech.com/about): Company overview, mission, vision, core values, team, and experience.
- [Services](https://www.flaremindstech.com/services): Comprehensive list of web development, app development, marketing, and software automation services.
- [Products & Portfolio](https://www.flaremindstech.com/products): Portfolio of client websites, e-commerce applications, mobile apps, and business systems.
- [Blog](https://www.flaremindstech.com/blog): Articles on web development, digital marketing, SEO strategies, and technology trends.
- [Contact Us](https://www.flaremindstech.com/contact): Get in touch for project quotes, consultations, and technical support.

## Core Services

- [Website Design & Development](https://www.flaremindstech.com/services/website-development): Custom responsive websites, MERN stack web applications, and UI/UX design.
- [SEO & Analytics](https://www.flaremindstech.com/services/seo-analytics): Search engine optimization, keyword strategy, and traffic analytics.
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.flaremindstech.com/services/mobile-app-development): iOS and Android cross-platform apps built with React Native.
- [E-Commerce Solutions](https://www.flaremindstech.com/services/e-commerce-solutions): Online stores, product catalogs, shopping carts, and payment integrations.
- [Business Applications](https://www.flaremindstech.com/services/business-applications): Custom CRM, ERP, HRMS, inventory tools, and admin dashboards.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://www.flaremindstech.com/services/social-media-marketing): Brand growth strategies across Instagram, Meta, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
